items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 97:1
items.html: For the four letters of HaVaYaH indicate Hochma, Bina, Tifferet and Malchut; and the uppermost Sefirot in the four worlds ABYA are likewise Hochma, Bina, Tifferet and Malchut. Therefore every world is named after the uppermost Sefira in it. (Chapter 8, Item 1)
